0022600172.text: The Miami Heat (1-4) visit the Los Angeles Lakers (4-1), with Miami 13th in the East and 5th in the Southeast, 2 games back, while Los Angeles is 1st in the Pacific and 3rd in the West. The Heat have won their most recent game but are 0-3 at home and 1-4 over their last ten, while the Lakers are 2-0 on the road and 4-1 over their last ten. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Miami lost the 2025-26 season series 0-2, most recently losing 134-126 in Miami on March 19, 2026.
